Processing.Process_Category: ultrasonic spray high temperature reduction self-assembly

Process_Text.original: GOx dispersion, MXene dispersion and L-ascorbic acid were ultrasonically treated, then droplets were sprayed into liquid paraffin at 150 °C by ultrasonic atomizer, collected by centrifugation, washed and freeze dried.
Process_Text.simplified: Disperse GOx and MXene; add L-ascorbic acid; ultrasound 30 min; ultrasonic atomization into 150 °C liquid paraffin; collect, wash and freeze dry.

Reducing_Agent.Name: L-ascorbic acid

FEI Verios G4 field emission SEM

Structure_Text.original: RGO and MXene were used as basic framework to form uniform microspheres with a diameter of about 6 μm. RGO/MXene showed typical shrinkage morphology. The epitaxial crimp of nanosheets was on the surface of microspheres.
Structure_Text.simplified: Uniform pleated RGO/MXene microspheres, about 6 μm diameter, formed from stacked 2D nanosheets with nanochannels.

Structure.Morphology: uniform microspheres with typical shrinkage morphology and epitaxial crimp of nanosheets on the surface

Processing.Process_Category: ultrasonic atomization followed by L-ascorbic acid reduction

Process_Text.original: GOx, MXene and Fe3O4 nanoparticles were added to 20 mL deionized water in a certain proportion. GOx/MXene/Fe3O4 microspheres were prepared by ultrasonic atomizer. The process conditions and washing process were same as that of RGO/MXene microspheres. After dispersing GOx/MXene/Fe3O4 in L-ascorbic acid aqueous solution with concentration of 3.6 mg/mL and reducing for 30 min at 90 °C, RGO/MXene/Fe3O4 microspheres were obtained by magnetic separation.
Process_Text.simplified: Mix GOx, MXene and Fe3O4 in water; ultrasonic atomize under the RGO/MXene spray conditions; wash; reduce in 3.6 mg/mL L-ascorbic acid at 90 °C for 30 min; magnetic separation.

Nozzle_Power_W.Original_Values: ultrasonic power applied on the nozzle was 1.5 W

FEI Verios G4 field emission SEM
